company_tagline: AI automation company with real freight industry credibility — but AI search engines aren't seeing the full picture yet.
executive_summary: La Crown Inc. is an AI automation company built by a 26-year freight industry veteran with a proven book of business and three live products: GEO Upward, AI Voice Agents, and SkillsForClaudeCode. The brand has real authority — but no llms.txt file, minimal schema markup, and thin service pages mean AI systems like ChatGPT and Perplexity are underrepresenting it in search results. The gap between La Crown's actual credibility and its AI-discoverable signals is entirely fixable. The core authority already exists — it just needs to be made machine-readable.

dimensions.name: AI Citability & Visibility
dimensions.description: Can AI platforms find and quote your content?

dimensions.name: Brand Authority Signals
dimensions.description: External signals that validate who you are

dimensions.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
dimensions.description: Depth, expertise, and trustworthiness of content

dimensions.name: Schema & Structured Data
dimensions.description: Schema markup giving AI systems structured facts

dimensions.name: Platform Optimization
dimensions.description: Presence on platforms AI systems index

findings.title: No llms.txt File
findings.description: There is no /llms.txt file. AI systems have no structured summary of the business, its products, or how to cite it. 30-minute fix with immediate AI visibility impact.

findings.title: AI Crawlers Not Addressed in robots.txt
findings.description: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended are not mentioned in robots.txt. Explicit Allow directives signal AI-friendliness and prevent accidental future blocking.

findings.title: No Schema Markup on Service Pages
findings.description: Service pages lack Organization, Service, and FAQPage schema. AI systems cannot extract structured facts about what the business offers or who it serves.

findings.title: No Wikipedia or Wikidata Entity
findings.description: No Wikipedia article or Wikidata entity exists. These are primary structured knowledge sources AI models use for entity recognition and authority verification.

findings.title: Thin About Page Content
findings.description: The About page does not fully surface 26 years of freight experience, $12M+ book of business, or the founding story. AI systems need verifiable credentials to cite an author or brand.

findings.title: Blog Posts Lack Author Credentials
findings.description: Articles display an author name but no title, bio, or verifiable credentials. AI systems cannot confirm author authority without structured E-E-A-T signals.

findings.title: No Reddit Presence
findings.description: Zero indexed Reddit discussions mention the brand. Perplexity AI heavily indexes Reddit. Community validation signals are missing across relevant subreddits.

findings.title: Missing Canonical Tags
findings.description: Pages lack canonical tags, creating potential duplicate content signals across HTTP/HTTPS and www/non-www variants.

quick_wins.title: Create /llms.txt at domain root
quick_wins.description: Describe the company, products (GEO Upward, Voice Agents, SkillsForClaudeCode), founder credentials, and key pages. Immediate AI visibility boost.

quick_wins.title: Update robots.txt with AI crawler directives
quick_wins.description: Add explicit Allow rules for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, and Google-Extended.

quick_wins.title: Create Wikidata entity
quick_wins.description: Add structured properties: founded date, headquarters, industry, key people, products. Primary knowledge source for AI entity recognition.

medium_term.title: Add Organization + Service JSON-LD to all pages
medium_term.description: Structured schema that tells AI systems exactly what the business does, who it serves, and how to contact it.

medium_term.title: Expand About page to 1,000+ words
medium_term.description: Add full founding story, 26-year freight background, $12M book of business, product timeline, and credentials. Make authority machine-readable.

medium_term.title: Add FAQPage schema to product pages
medium_term.description: GEO Upward, Voice Agents, and SkillsForClaudeCode pages should each have FAQ schema. Feeds Google AI Overviews and Bing Copilot directly.

medium_term.title: Add author bio blocks to all blog posts
medium_term.description: Full credentials: Operations Manager, 26 years freight, founder of La Crown. Real credentials AI systems can verify and cite.

strategic.title: Publish quarterly GEO industry report
strategic.description: Proprietary data and analysis from real GEO audits. Creates the definitive resource AI systems will cite when answering questions about AI visibility.

strategic.title: Build topical authority with case studies
strategic.description: Document real client results from GEO Upward audits. Before/after scores, specific fixes implemented, outcomes. Verifiable proof AI can cite.

strategic.title: Establish Reddit presence in relevant subs
strategic.description: Authentic posts in r/freightbrokers, r/SEO, r/artificial, r/ClaudeAI. Builds community validation signals AI systems index heavily.

methodology: This GEO audit analyzed lacrown.ai across six weighted dimensions: AI Citability & Visibility (25%), Brand Authority Signals (20%), Content Quality & E-E-A-T (20%), Technical Foundations (15%), Schema & Structured Data (10%), and Platform Optimization (10%). Platforms assessed: Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT Web Search, Perplexity AI, Google Gemini, Bing Copilot. Audit date: March 10, 2026.
